kind.description: `agent` for an API key, `human` for a browser session.

version_id.description:
The version that fixes the comment: a version of the comment's doc saved
after the version the comment was made on.

prefix.description: The public handle that finds the key; not secret.

scopes.description: What the key may do. v1 issues full-access keys only: `["*"]`.

ApprovedVersion.description: The version of a doc that the human approved.

content_type.description:
Decided from the file's bytes: `image/*`, `font/*` or
`application/octet-stream`.

kind.description:
`image` (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF), `font` (WOFF2, TTF, OTF) or `file`
(anything else, download only).

ref.description: How docs, designs and posts refer to the file: `attachment:<id>`.

changeset_id.description: The change set whose draft was read; left out for a version.

draft_id.description: The draft that was read; left out for a version.

page_id.description: The page that holds the board.

tags.description:
The board and its subtree in the tag format (docs/formats/design-tags.md),
without its page. For a draft, every tag carries `rev={n}`, the
node's revision; a version's tags carry none.

version_id.description: The version that was read; `null` for a draft.

approved_versions.description:
What the human approved: the latest version saved in the change set
for each doc that has one, removals included. Empty while the change
set has no approval (saving a version clears it).

decisions.description:
The decisions the change set carries out, in the order they were
linked; empty while it has none.

ClaimBody.description: A claim as the API shows it.

agent.description:
The holder: `run`, `role`, `model` and `harness`, each `null` when the
request did not declare it.

expires_at.description: The holder's last operation in the draft (or `taken_at`) plus the TTL.

node.description: The ID of the board or section.

index.description:
The position of the operation in the batch, counting from 0; absent for
a request to claim.

message.description: Names the holder, as `<run>/<role>`, and the claimed node.

CommentBody.description: A comment pinned to a node of a saved version.

addressed_in.description: The version that an agent named when it marked the comment addressed.

changeset_id.description:
The change set of the version, while it is under review; `null` for a
comment on the mainline, which is one whose change set has merged.

compared_to.description:
The version the node is compared with: the newest version of the doc
saved in the comment's change set, or the doc's mainline version for a
mainline comment.

node.description:
The node address as it was sent: a node ID of the version, or
`<instanceId>/<componentNodeId>` inside a component instance.

node_status.description:
`current` when the version that the comment is compared with has the node
as it was, `changed` when it has the node with other content (the comment
was made on an older version) and `removed` when it no longer has the
node.

version_id.description: The version the comment was made on; it never changes.

current_html.description:
The node as it is now: HTML with `data-node-id` for an HTML doc, tags
with `rev` for a design.

current_revision.description: The revision the node has now.

index.description: The position of the operation in the batch, counting from 0.

ConflictKind.description: What kind of conflict a rebase recorded.

ConflictResolution.description: How the agent resolved a conflict.

ConflictSide.description:
One side of a conflict: the version that its state of the node comes from
and the node there.

html.description:
The node and what is inside it as HTML with `data-node-id`; `null` when
this side removed the node.

run_tag.description: The run (such as a UI research run) that the change set belongs to.

node.description:
A node ID of the version, or `<instanceId>/<componentNodeId>` for a node
inside a component instance of a design version.

text.description: What the comment says; not blank.

summary.description: One line of at most 200 characters; required.

module.description: `prd`, `architecture` or `db` for `html`, `ui` for the design kinds.

attachments.description: IDs of the workspace's attachments, in order. Defaults to none.

confidence.description: How sure the author is, from 0 to 1.

links.description:
What the post points to, in order: `{"kind": "post", "post_id"}` (a post
of the project), `{"kind": "url", "url"}` (an http or https address),
`{"kind": "node", "doc_id", "address"}` (a doc of the project and a
node address) and `{"kind": "attachment", "attachment_id"}`. Defaults
to none.

replaces.description:
The earlier post of this thread by the same author (an agent's run and
role) that this one replaces. That post stays as it was.

summary.description: One line of at most 200 characters; required.

type.description:
The kind of post: `note`, `finding`, `position`, `objection`, `support`,
`question`, `directive` or `verdict`; required. Only the human posts a
`directive`.

criteria.description: The decision criteria, one text each; required, and may be empty.

question.description: The question to work out; required.

sealed.description: Whether the first phase is sealed. Defaults to `false`.

draft.description: The change set's draft of the new doc: empty, and based on no version.

secret.description:
The whole key, to send as `Authorization: Bearer <secret>`. It is shown
only in this response.

DecisionBody.description:
A decision as the API answers it: the proposed fields as they were sent,
with its status and where it belongs.

changeset_id.description: The change set of the thread.

posts.description: The posts the decision relies on. An agent gets only those it may read.

rejection_reason.description: Why the human rejected it; kept after the decision is superseded.

DecisionFile.description:
The decision file of `omni decision propose`. Every field is required and
no other field is accepted.

chosen.description: The name of the option that won.

criteria.description: What the options were scored on: at least one, not blank, all different.

posts.description: IDs of posts of the thread that the proposing agent identity may read.

DecisionOption.description: One option that the thread considered.

lost_because.description:
Why the option lost: text that is not blank for every option but the
chosen one, `null` (or left out) for the chosen one.

name.description: Not blank, and no two options have the same name.

scores.description:
One number for each criterion, keyed by the criterion's text, and
nothing else.

added.description: The nodes only the second version has.

changed.description: The nodes of both whose own content differs, as in the second version.

from_design_system_version_id.description:
The design system version that the first version recorded; `null` for
versions of other docs.

moved.description:
The nodes of both whose place differs: another parent, or, for a
reorder among the siblings that keep their parent, the fewest nodes
that account for it.

removed.description: The nodes only the first version has.

to_design_system_version_id.description: The design system version that the second version recorded.

DigestEntry.description: A post in a digest: what it is, without its text.

posts.description: The posts the caller may read, oldest first.

Dissent.description: Who disagrees with the decision and why.

claims.description: The doc's live claims, oldest first.

drafts.description: The doc's drafts, one per change set, oldest first.

mainline_version_id.description: `null` until a change set that holds the doc's first version merges.

base_version_id.description:
The version the draft started from; `null` for a new doc, whose first
version comes through this change set.

doc_id.description: The project's design system doc; `null` when the project has none.

draft_id.description: The change set's draft of the design system; `null` when it has none.

mode.description: The mode that `tokens` is the tree of; only with `?mode=`.

modes.description: The design system's modes, in order; empty before the first import.

tokens.description:
The token tree of the draft; `null` before the first import. With
`?mode=`, the tree of that one mode.

components.description: The components that a design doc's instances use, as resolved.

design_system.description:
The design system that a design doc's instances resolve against:
`{"doc_id", "source", "draft_id", "version_id"}`, where `source` is
`draft` (the change set's draft of the design system, with its
`draft_id`), `mainline` (the mainline version, with its `version_id`) or
`null` (no components yet).

html.description:
The draft as HTML: `data-node-id` and `data-rev` (the node's revision)
on every block; empty for a design doc, whose content is `tags` and
`pages`.

pages.description: A design doc's pages as JSON nodes.

tags.description: A design doc's pages as tags, with every ID.

board.description:
For a design: the ID of a board that every operation must stay inside
(its node, and its parent for an insert or a move, are the board or in
it). An ID that is no board of the doc is 404 `unknown_board`.

results.description: One result per operation, in order.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every error response: a stable code such as `unauthorized`.

HistoryEntry.description:
One status change of a change set. The entry that creates it has no
`from_status`.

actor.description:
`agent` or `human`, or `system` when the server moved the change set
itself (saving a version clears an approval).

reason.description: Only set when the human rejected the change set.

tags.description:
The tags of docs/formats/design-tags.md: `<Component>` tags for the
components of a design system, `<Page>` tags for a design.

tokens.description: The whole token tree, in the DTCG format of docs/formats/tokens.md.

components.description: The components as JSON nodes of type `component`, in the order written.

draft_id.description: The change set's draft of the design system.

tags.description: The components as tags, with every ID, in the order written.

draft_id.description: The change set's draft of the design doc.

pages.description: The pages as JSON nodes, in the order written.

tags.description: The pages as tags, with every ID.

message.description:
What is wrong; it names the line of the tags, the component, the
property, the value or the node.

index.description: The position of the operation in the batch, counting from 0.

message.description: What is wrong; it names an ID that is not in the draft.
What is wrong; it names the token, the mode or the attachment.

LinkedDecision.description: A decision that a change set carries out (US-037), with its status now.

status.description:
`proposed`, `approved`, `rejected` or `superseded`. The change set
cannot be approved while one linked decision is not `approved`.

LiveClientMessage.description:
The message a client sends over the socket. It exists to put the protocol
in the OpenAPI document, from which the web app generates its types and Zod
schemas; the socket parses the text frames itself (`parse_subscribe`).

oneOf.description: Starts (or resumes) the events of one project.

after.description:
The newest sequence number the client already has. Left out, only
the events from now on are sent.

LiveErrorCode.description: Why a message of the client was not served.

LiveEventName.description:
Every event the API emits, as `<entity>.<action>`. The `changeset.*` events
are named after the status the change set moved to.

LiveServerMessage.description:
A message the server sends over the socket (see the module documentation
for the protocol).

oneOf.description: The answer to a subscribe, before the events it asked for.

last_seq.description: The newest sequence number of the project at the time.

oneOf.description:
One event of a project. `seq` counts the events of the project, one at
a time.

at.description: When the event happened, ISO 8601 in UTC.

data.description: What the event is about; its fields depend on the event.

oneOf.description: A mistake of the client; the socket stays open.

html.description: The version as HTML with `data-node-id`; the empty text without a version.

version_id.description: The version that was read; `null` when the doc has no mainline version.

doc_id.description: The project's design system doc; `null` when the project has none.

mode.description: The mode that `tokens` is the tree of; only with `?mode=`.

modes.description: The design system's modes, in order; empty without a version.

tokens.description:
The token tree of the version; `null` without a version. With `?mode=`,
the tree of that one mode.

version_id.description:
The version that was read; `null` when the design system has no
mainline version yet.

Manifest.description: The chunks of a design version: its pages in order, each with its boards.

ManifestBoard.description: A board of a page in a manifest.

chunk.description:
The name of the board's chunk: the BLAKE3 hash of its bytes, 64
lowercase hexadecimal characters.

ManifestPage.description: A page of a manifest, with its boards in order.

chunk.description: The name of the page's chunk, which holds the page without its boards.

MovedNode.description:
A node whose place differs: it moved to another parent, or its order among
the siblings that keep their parent changed.

from_after.description:
The sibling the node follows in the first version; `null` for a first
child.

to_after.description:
The sibling the node follows in the second version; `null` for a first
child.

NodeEntry.description: One node of a version's index.

fingerprint.description:
A hash of the node's own content: its type, properties and text, and
nothing else. It does not change when a child or the node's place does.

parent.description: The parent's node ID; `null` at the top level.

type.description: The block's type: `section`, `heading`, `paragraph` and so on.

created.description: The IDs the server assigned to new nodes, in document order.

node.description: The node the operation inserted, replaced, set, moved or deleted.

removed.description: The nodes the operation removed, in document order.

revision.description: The node's revision after the operation.

number.description: From 1; the thread's last phase is its current one.

posted_by.description:
The distinct agent identities that have posted in this phase, in the
order of their first post there. Told to every caller, also in a
sealed phase: it says who has posted, never what (US-036). The human is
never in it.

sealed.description:
A sealed phase hides the posts of other agents from an agent that has
not posted in it yet (US-034); an open phase does not.

author.description:
`{"kind": "agent", "run", "role", "model", "harness"}` for an agent
(each `null` when the request did not say), or `{"kind": "human",
"user_id"}`.

body.description: The Markdown as it was sent.

body_html.description:
The body rendered to HTML with raw HTML switched off, links only to
http, https and mailto, and images only from `attachment:<id>`.

phase.description: The number of the thread's phase that the post was made in.

PosterBody.description: An agent identity that has posted in a phase.

name.description: Unique in the workspace; the omni CLI accepts it where it takes a project.

conflicts.description: The conflicts that this rebase recorded; empty for a clean one.

RecordedConflict.description:
A node that a rebase could not merge, as it recorded it: one that both the
mainline and the change set changed, or one the change set added that has
no place on the mainline.

changeset.description: The node in the change set's latest version of the doc.

mainline.description: The node in the mainline version that the rebase found.

oneOf.description: `null` until the agent resolves the conflict.

reason.description: Why the decision is rejected; required, not blank.
Why the change set is rejected; required.

note.description: How the conflict was resolved; required.

SaveVersionRequest.description:
What saving a version takes: nothing, but the body must be a JSON object.
A version that drops a node with an open comment is refused unless the body
says `remove_commented`.

remove_commented.description:
Save even though the version removes nodes that have open comments (the
comments stay, marked as removed). Left out or `false`, such a save is
refused with 409 `commented_nodes_removed`.

SinglePostResponse.description: A post read on its own, with the project it belongs to.

sealed.description: Whether the new phase is sealed; required.

criteria.description: The decision criteria, in the order the agent gave them.

decision.description:
The thread's current decision (US-037): the newest, which is not
superseded, as the decision routes answer it, so with at least its `id`
and `status`; `null` while the thread has none. An agent gets only the
posts of it that it may read.

posts.description:
The posts the caller may read, oldest first. Only in the answer to a
read of the thread; an agent does not get what a sealed phase hides.

run_tag.description: The run of the agent that started the thread.

UsageBoard.description: A board that uses a component.

components.description: The IDs of the components the board uses.

version_id.description: The doc's mainline version that was read.

component.description: The component that was asked for; `null` for every component.

components.description:
The components that a design version's instances use, as the recorded
design system version defines them; for a design system version, all of
its components. Only when the version is read by ID.

design_system_version_id.description:
For a design version, the version of the design system it was saved
against, which every view of it uses; `null` for other versions.

oneOf.description:
For a design version, the chunk of each of its pages and boards, so
that a viewer can read one board and an unchanged board is the same
chunk in every version that has it; `null` for other versions.

nodes.description: The version's nodes in document order.

pages.description: A design version's pages as JSON nodes; only when read by ID.

removed.description: Whether this version marks the doc as removed; it then has no nodes.

tags.description: A design version's pages as tags; only when the version is read by ID.

info.description: The HTTP API behind the OmniState web app and the `omni` command line. An agent request that succeeds inside a change set (a path under `/changesets/{changeset_id}` or `/threads/{thread_id}`) is answered with a `directives` list next to its usual fields: the human's directive posts that the agent identity (run and role) has not been given yet, oldest first. The field is left out when there are none.

post.summary:
Approves a change set that is in review: records the latest saved version
of each changed doc, then merges them when every doc's base is still its
mainline version, or moves the change set to `needs_rebase` when one is not
(nothing merges then). The change set row is locked first, so only one
request decides its fate, and the docs are locked in ID order, so of two
change sets on the same base that are approved at once the first merges and
the second finds the new mainline and needs a rebase. Both moves are made by
the server (actor `system`) in the transaction of the approval.

with each node's ID, type, parent and fingerprint. The draft stays open for
more operations. A version does not become the doc's mainline version; that

post.summary:
Rebases a change set that `needs_rebase` onto the current mainline. The
agent's changes are replayed onto each doc whose draft is based on an
outdated version, which gives a new version of the change set. Without
conflicts the approval is kept and the change set merges; with conflicts
nothing merges, the approval is cleared and the change set is `open`, with
each conflicting node as the mainline has it in the draft. A removed doc is
a doc-level change: removed on one side and changed on the other is a
conflict that keeps the mainline state. A draft with operations after its
latest saved version is not rebased (409 `unsaved_operations`).
